fields.description:
The AWS review-bot holds a persistent tickets clone that a redeploy does not refresh, and it writes on every Gerrit vote. Make the clone self-converge after the epoch guard has landed, and fix the deploy path so later ensure-script changes reach the box automatically. Session log **1cb6-d553-6565-49b4** contains the measured facts.

## Why

The clone lives on the EBS-backed external volume declared in `infra/compose/docker-compose.yml`. The generated entrypoint in `infra/compose/Dockerfile.reviewbot:127-149` clones only when `${REVIEWBOT_TICKETS_DIR}/.git` is absent, so a normal redeploy preserves any divergent history. The entrypoint invokes `reviewbot-ensure-tickets.sh` outside the PAT block, so convergence must still run when `REVIEWBOT_TICKETS_PAT` is unset.

`infra/scripts/reviewbot-ensure-tickets.sh:50-69` currently configures the repo-local identity and runs the ensure registry, but does not fetch, classify ancestry, or reset a divergent persistent clone. The bot uses `REBAR_SYNC_PUSH=always`; its artifact writer runs after the Gerrit vote and catches store errors inside `src/rebar/review_bot/artifact_emit.py:56-166`, while the call site is `src/rebar/review_bot/voter.py:719`. Convergence failure must remain best-effort and must never undo or wedge an already-cast vote.

## Deployment bootstrap

`infra/scripts/autodeploy.sh:90` omits `infra/scripts/reviewbot-ensure-tickets.sh` from `BOT_PATHS`. The deploy decision at `:276` and rsync at `:334` therefore cannot deliver a first commit that changes only these scripts. This ticket depends on A6-0a and lands **after A6-0a**, as its own independently reviewable Gerrit change.

After this scripts-only change merges, perform the documented one-time hand-deploy from `infra/runbooks/review-bot-ops.md`: update `/var/lib/rebar/mirror`, install the merged `infra/scripts/autodeploy.sh` into `/opt/rebar` while preserving owner `502:502`, and start `rebar-autodeploy.service`. The newly installed `BOT_PATHS` then detects the ensure-script change and performs the normal rsync/build/health workflow. Future ensure-script changes self-deploy without another bootstrap.

## What

1. Before fetching, record the exact local `tickets` tip and the previously observed `refs/remotes/origin/tickets` tip. Fetch with the load-bearing explicit refspec `+refs/heads/tickets:refs/remotes/origin/tickets`; the classifier reads that freshly advanced remote-tracking ref. If fetch fails because credentials are absent or the origin is unreachable, preserve the local tip, emit an operator-readable warning, and return success so `set -eu` cannot abort an already-cast vote.
2. Preserve the existing union safety invariant for compatible stores: use `rebar._store.sync.reconverge` for equal, behind, ahead, and same-epoch divergent histories. It keeps local-only commits rather than resetting them.
3. Add one narrow boot-time adoption path for the reclaim: reset the dedicated review-bot `tickets` branch to the pinned newly fetched commit only when the local record is pre-epoch, the remote record has a valid string epoch, the prior remote tip was readable, and the pre-fetch local tip is an ancestor of that prior remote tip. Those preconditions prove the clone has no local-only commit to lose. If the local tip was ahead/diverged from the prior remote, the prior remote is unreadable, either record is corrupt, or the mismatch is anything other than absent-to-present, preserve the local tip exactly, warn, and require operator intervention. No recovery ref pins the reclaimed object graph.
4. Add `infra/scripts/reviewbot-ensure-tickets.sh` to `autodeploy.sh` `BOT_PATHS`. Preserve ensure execution outside the PAT block and preserve best-effort vote safety.
5. Hand-bootstrap the first deployment after merge, then record the deployed main SHA or image digest, the successful autodeploy/health receipt, a deployed-runtime epoch-mismatch refusal probe, and the persistent-clone convergence result.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [x] [code-verifiable] A successful fetch advances the exact `refs/remotes/origin/tickets` ref read by the classifier by using `+refs/heads/tickets:refs/remotes/origin/tickets`. Tier: shell integration.
- [x] [code-verifiable] A failed or credentialless explicit-refspec fetch exits best-effort success, preserves the exact local tip, and emits an operator-readable warning. Tier: shell integration with a failing remote.
- [x] [code-verifiable] A table-driven shell integration proves compatible equal, behind, and strictly-ahead clones preserve or converge to the exact expected tip through the existing reconverge path.
- [x] [code-verifiable] A compatible same-epoch divergent clone unions through the existing reconverge path and preserves both the local-only and remote-only event commits. Tier: real-clone integration.
- [x] [code-verifiable] A pre-epoch clone whose pre-fetch local tip is an ancestor of its readable prior remote tip adopts the pinned newly fetched epoch-bearing remote commit exactly. Tier: real-clone integration.
- [x] [code-verifiable] The reclaim adoption path never resolves the remote target a second time between validation and reset. Tier: integration with a moving remote-tracking ref.
- [x] [code-verifiable] Local-ahead and local-diverged pre-fetch states refuse reclaim adoption and preserve the exact local tip. Tier: table-driven real-clone integration.
- [x] [code-verifiable] A missing prior remote, a corrupt epoch record, or a mismatch other than pre-epoch-to-valid-epoch refuses reclaim adoption and preserves the exact local tip. Tier: table-driven integration.
- [x] [code-verifiable] Every refused adoption emits an operator-readable manual-intervention warning. Tier: integration with captured stderr.
- [x] [code-verifiable] Every convergence/adoption case leaves no merge or stash state. Tier: shell integration.
- [x] [code-verifiable] With `REVIEWBOT_TICKETS_PAT` unset, the generated entrypoint still invokes ensure/convergence against an existing clone outside the PAT block. Tier: shell integration through the generated entrypoint.
- [x] [code-verifiable] `infra/scripts/reviewbot-ensure-tickets.sh` appears in `autodeploy.sh` `BOT_PATHS`.
- [x] [code-verifiable] A path-classifier test proves a change to `infra/scripts/reviewbot-ensure-tickets.sh` selects the review-bot deploy branch.
- [x] [code-verifiable] An injected rebar store write failure after `post_vote` leaves the Gerrit vote recorded and returns normally through the existing best-effort artifact path. Tier: unit at the artifact/caller boundary.
- [x] [operator-attested] The merged A6-0b SHA or image digest, one-time hand-bootstrap exits, successful autodeploy and review-bot health receipts, deployed-runtime epoch-mismatch refusal output, and persistent-clone old/new tips are recorded on this ticket before closure.

## Scope

`infra/scripts/reviewbot-ensure-tickets.sh`, `infra/scripts/autodeploy.sh`, `infra/compose/Dockerfile.reviewbot` tests only if required for generated-entrypoint coverage, and focused tests.

Scope: S. Depends on A6-0a; lands after A6-0a as its own change.
